events.snippet: Waldo Issue Tracker: Black zinc plating chipping, chassis deformation, burr edges.
Sample allocation: Bare PCBs, Batteries, LCM modules assigned to engineering team.
Defect: Sativa/Elvis label edge lift. Proposal: Switch 3M 467 to 9453LE.
Adhesive Validation: 3M 9453LE undergoing thermal shock. 1 unit passed.
ECN generated for label adhesive change to 3M 9453LE.
Production Mark: MFG DATE recorded on Rocky4 carton label.
Verification: Gloss surface change noted on Waldo units (Sunny Yen).
Reliability Crisis: Drop Test FAIL (LCM crack). Storage Temp FAIL (Cap floating).
Blocker: Dust Test FAIL. Units cannot be removed from Bazooka chassis.
Structural Failure: Back cover & front housing detach during Crush Test.
Redlines issued for Bazooka Metal Front Housing (0048-BZKA-01).
Drawing Revision: ASSY, FRONT HOUSING SATIVA (740-00049).
Tracker Update: Monitoring DVT components (Nuts, Glass, Labels).
Drop Test (1.3m): Internal loose parts audible on Sativa #6 / Elvis #7.
Drop Test Breakthrough: Sativa #2 / Elvis #2 PASS 1.3m drops.
Cosmetic Fail: Protective film glue residue remaining on Waldo surface.
Command Decision: Norris overrides 'Wet Hands' failure. Proceeds with FAIL result.
